translation: When it moves it causes lower abdominal pain drawing to the heart, back pain, dribbling urination; in women, when menstruation comes, it rushes upward to the chest and heart, with fullness of the flanks and cramping of the inner thigh. When the front region is straight in the center, it is the hand Lesser Yin Heart and hand Greater Yang Small Intestine; when it moves it causes firm pain below the heart and urgency of the abdomen and flanks. Excess and rapid is being startled and offended; vacuity is diarrhea with intestinal rumbling; in women, itching and pain within the genitals; slippery is pregnancy.
